verdict.rationale: Tilled is a payments platform, not an AI agent product; this MCP-server story applies to whether Tilled ships an official MCP server for agent integration, but there's a more fitting boundary here: Tilled is not itself an agent, so the axis in principle applies, but evidence shows no MCP server exists—only a standard REST API and explicit absence of agent-oriented docs. This is 'none' rather than 'na' since a payments platform could plausibly ship an MCP server for agent integration.
